title: CR-PAY-049 — WO + payments + AP/AR + history
preconds: Permissions (counted): WO View + Invoicing V+E + See AP/AR + History Logs. Auto-gate forced ON (not counted): See Fin. View Mode: Full unless noted. All other permissions OFF.
steps:
1. Create a custom role with the permissions listed in Preconditions; leave all others OFF.
  2. Assign the role to a test user and log in.
  3. Exercise each capability in Expected Result and confirm it succeeds (and that gated pricing is hidden where noted).
expected:
User CAN: See WOs; create invoices; process payments; deposits; send to terminal; AP/AR payment tabs; aging; bulk payments; view payment/invoice history logs

Risk / Rationale: Positive capability check — confirms this combination grants exactly the listed actions and nothing gated leaks.
Spec Ref: §1a+§1h+§5b+§5c
